decisive_spans.text: Immunohistochemical analysis: Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100

response.rationale: The immunohistochemical analysis showing diffuse positivity for protein S-100 strongly supports Schwannoma (D1) and contradicts Meningioma (D7).
